column1: # OWASP ZAP Baseline Scan Rule Configuration for TaxPulse
# Policy (ADR-0026): 0 Medium-or-above alerts allowed (fail on Medium+).
# Real security headers (CSP, Anti-clickjacking, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS) MUST FAIL on violation.
# Informational findings are tuned with documented justifications below.

column3: Anti-clickjacking Header Missing (Must enforce DENY or frame-ancestors 'none')
Strict-Transport-Security Header Missing (Must enforce HSTS in production)
Server Leaks Information via X-Powered-By Header (Must disable x-powered-by)
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set (Must enforce default-src 'self')
Storable and Cacheable Content - Health and OpenAPI endpoints provide explicit Cache-Control headers
Timestamp Disclosure - Unix timestamps in OpenAPI JSON metadata and event envelopes are standard and non-sensitive
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments - Standard API documentation comments
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy Header - Handled via dedicated CORS middleware configuration
